title: Star Detective Precure! Film Becomes Highest-Grossing Standalone Film in Precure Franchise
content:
The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — announced on Sunday that the film has sold 977,000 tickets and has earned an estimated 1.24 billion yen (about US$7.8 million) in its first month. The film has already surpassed the 1.24 billion yen total earnings of the 2024 Wonderful Precure! The Movie! Dokidoki♡Game no Sekai de Daibōken! film, making it the franchise 's highest-grossing standalone film.

The film opened in Japan on September 18, and ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 358,000 tickets to earn 446 million yen (about US$2.82 million) in its first three days.

The film's story begins with the Detective Precures investigating the "X Mark Incident," when a fairy named Rain appears and requests for the Detective Precures' help. Rain leads the team to a lovely garden called "Karin's Garden," but it is being overrun by tiny creatures called "Dame Dame." The team investigates the "Dame Dame" creatures and discovers the secret hidden in the garden.

The cast members who voice the film's original characters are:

• Akari Kitō as Karin, a 14-year-old girl who holds the key to the story

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Alan, a fairy who watches over Karin

• Kōki Uchiyama as Rain, a fairy who requests the Detective Precures' help

Past Precure characters from You and Idol Precure♪ and Wonderful Precure! also appear in the film.

Hanako Ueda ( You and Idol Precure♪ , Summer Time Rendering My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON episode director) directed the film. Yoshimi Narita ( Eiga HappinessCharge PreCure! Ningyō no Kuni no Ballerina , Eiga Precure All Stars New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi , Eiga Tropical-Rouge! Precure: Yuki no Princess to Kiseki no Yubiwa! films) wrote the script, Erika Fukasawa ( Eiga Kimi to Idol Precure♪ Omatase! Kimi ni Todokeru Kirakkilive! ) and Misaki Umase ( You and Idol Precure♪ ) composed the music, and Emiko Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure All Stars F , Precure Super Stars! original character designer) designed the characters and was also the film's chief animation director.

Additional staff members include art director Risa Fujii , color key artist Satoshi Takezawa , compositing director of photography Takumi Arai , and production manager Hirotaka Naota .

Yūka Masui and Chihaya Yoshitake perform the film's ending theme song "FIRST PRISM." Ami Ishii performs the insert song "First Step."

The Star Detective Precure! anime debuted on February 1 on ABC TV, TV Asahi , and their affiliate channels at 8:30 a.m. JST. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in North America, Central America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and CIS.

The anime centers on Anna Akechi, a second year middle school student who lives in Makoto Mirai Town. She travels back in time from 2027 to 1999 when her "companion fairy" named Pochitan appears on her birthday. In 1999 Makoto Mirai Town, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, another second year middle school student who dreams of becoming a great detective. The two girls witness the troubles caused by the Phantom Thieves who steal people's precious belongings, and they transform into great Precure detectives and use their deductive reasoning skills to protect the people's smiles.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Adds Psyren Anime's English Dub
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Sunday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga on Monday. The dub cast — under dub director Dani Chambers , producer Zach Bolton , script adapter James Cheek , mixer William Dewell , and engineer Jose Sandoval — includes:

• Dylan Ray Owen as Ageha

• Kelly Greenshield as Amamiya

• Katelyn Barr as Fubiki

• Kevin D. Thelwell as Hiroki

• Jacob Browning as Miyake

• Abigail Blythe as Nemesis Q

• Derrick Snow as Okumura

• Mauricio Ortiz-Segura as Saka

• Daniel Van Thomas as Usui

The anime debuted on October 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.

Global Stage Hollywood screened the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival on October 3 at the Chinese Theater in Hollywood, California. The first episode also screened its West Coast premiere during the event. The manga's original creator Iwashiro was in attendance at the screening.

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!" Who-ya Extended performs the ending theme song "ICARUS."

REMOW describes the anime:

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psy ren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
content:
Visual Arts/Key announced on Monday that writer and composer Jun Maeda ( Kanon , Air , Clannad , Angel Beats! ) has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer, and has chosen to focus on palliative care, after considering his condition and the outlook for possible treatment.

The announcement also included an e-mail and mailing address for fans to send Maeda a message or letter of encouragement. The staff will accept letters only, and asked fans to refrain from sending gifts or other get-well items. The staff added Maeda is currently hospitalized, but "remains strongly determined to devote himself to creative work through to the very end."

The announcement stated that Maeda has finished work for the first six chapters of the Heaven Burns Red game , including all the major story elements that will take the story to the end of the sixth chapter. He has also completed the lyrics and composition for the songs in the first half of the sixth chapter. Maeda may no longer be able to fulfill further writing and songwriting duties aside from the above mentioned segments depending on the progression of his illness.

The announcement also noted that Maeda was working on launching an original music project on YouTube with new songs "over the long term," but that, after learning of his diagnosis, he has decided to focus on completing the songs currently in development "as quickly as possible," which will be released sequentially on YouTube at Maeda's request.

Maeda was hospitalized for five months in 2016, and is suffering from idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy (unexplained enlargement and weakening of the heart's left ventricle). He revealed later that year that his heart condition requires a heart transplant, although he later reassured fans that he still had long to live, and would still write more stories.

Maeda first worked on visual novels with Tactics / NEXTON 's Moon and ONE in 1997 and 1998, respectively. The core team for both visual novels would eventually break off from Tactics to make visual novels and stories under the new circle Key . There, Maeda is known for writing the Visual Arts/Key visual novels Kanon , Air , Clannad , and Little Busters! , all of which received anime adaptations. His early works with Key are iconic to bishojo visual novels, and are often dubbed as "nakige" (crying games) by enthusiasts for their penchant for storylines where characters grapple with and find ways to come to terms with death, loss, tragedy, and sacrifice. The stories are some of the best known in the visual novel medium, and continue to be influential today.

Maeda also composed the music for the visual novels he has written, and composed themes as well as wrote the story for both Angel Beats! and Charlotte . He has composed, or otherwise supervised the musical production, for other Key visual novels, such as Kud Wafter , Rewrite , and Prima Doll . Maeda is credited with the original work and as scriptwriter for Key , Aniplex , and P.A. Works ' The Day I Became a God anime.

Maeda provided the original concept for the Summer Pockets game that debuted for Windows PC in June 2018 and for iOS and Android devices in December 2018. The game got a television anime adaptation in June 2025.

Maeda's Heaven Burns Red game launched in February 2022, and is his first completely new game in 13 years. As stated above, the game features a scenario whose first six chapters (which the game is still currently progressing through) written by Maeda, as well as original songs for the game composed by Maeda, performed by various singers. The game's staff had stated in August the game had started the final chapter of its main story.

title: Cygames States Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Franchise's U.S. Concerts May Be Canceled Due to Visa Issues
content:
The staff stated they have been working with lawyers and promoters in the U.S. to secure the necessary visas for over six months. Staff added they are "coordinating with all parties concerned to explore every possible option to get the visas approved and make the concerts happen."

The staff will announce the final decision — whether it is possible to hold the concerts or not — by Monday, October 19 at 10:00 p.m. PDT (Tuesday, October 20 at 1:00 a.m. EDT).

The staff apologized for the concern and inconvenience, and for giving the announcement close to the event date.

The Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concert is scheduled on October 22 at 8:00 p.m. PDT and October 23 at 7:00 p.m. PDT at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

The cast includes:

• Machico (Tokai Teio)

• Tomoyo Takayanagi (Oguri Cap)

• Rena Maeda (Grass Wonder)

• Minami Takahashi (El Condor Pasa)

• Yui Ogura (Manhattan Cafe)

• Hitomi Sasaki (Admire Vega)

• Yukina Shutō (Haru Urara)

• Misaki Watada (Meisho Doto)

• Kaori Maeda (Nice Nature)

• Hikaru Tōno (Matikanetannhauser)

• Hina Tachibana (Satono Diamond)

• Hinaki Yano (Kitasan Black)

• Kanna Nakamura (Narita Top Road)

• Yūko Natsuyoshi (Cheval Grand)

• Haruna Fukushima (Dantsu Flame)

• Yuri Fujimoto (Jungle Pocket)

• Sayaka Kikuchi (Hokko Tarumae)

The tour had its first event in Tokyo on June 20-21. The tour will have stops in Los Angeles, London, Seoul, and Yokohama. This marks the first time the franchise 's live musical events will be performed globally.

The 6th EVENT The New Frontier ran in Saitama in May 2025 and October 2025.

The Uma Musume Pretty Derby game launched in February 2021 for iOS and Android. The game was originally slated for a release in winter 2018, and was delayed in order to raise the game's quality. The game launched on PC via DMM Games in March 2021.

The game launched in English for iOS and Android devices on June 26, 2025. The game won Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025 event last December.

The game's concept begins with Uma Musume (Horse Girls), girls endowed with excellent running capability, and who aim to become top idols and compete in the national sports entertainment show "Twinkle Series." Players take the role of both teacher and trainer for the girls in the Nihon Uma Musume Training Center Gakuen (Japan Horse Girls Training Center Academy) and help them make their debut.

title: New Live-Action Street Fighter Film Opens at #1 in the U.S., Earns US$51 Million Globally
content:
Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series ranked at #1 in the United States box office in its opening weekend with an estimated US$31 million. It also earned an estimated US$20.1 million in 65 markets outside of the U.S., for an estimated US$51.1 million opening weekend globally. The film's IMAX screenings earned US$7.7 million globally, with US$5.4 million of that earned in the U.S., and US$2.3 million from overseas markets.

The Deadline entertainment news source reported that while the opening total is lower than the US$70 million the staff had "hoped for," the revenues from ancillary sources will eventually make up for the US$ 82-million production budget.

The film opened on October 16.

Paramount Pictures describes the story:

Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu ( Andrew Koji ) and Ken Masters ( Noah Centineo ) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li ( Callina Liang ) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

The cast includes:

• Andrew Koji as Ryu

• Noah Centineo as Ken

• Rayna Vallandingham as Juli

• Orville Peck as Vega

• Mel Jarnson as Cammy

• Jason Momoa as Blanka

• Eric André as Don Sauvage

• David Dastmalchian as M. Bison

• Cody Rhodes as Guile

• Callina Liang as Chun-Li

• Andrew Schulz as Dan Hibiki

• Roman Reigns as Akuma

• Alex Volkanovski as Joe

• Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson as Balrog

• Olivier Richters as Zangief

• Hirooki Gotō as E. Honda

• Vidyut Jammwal as Dhalsim

Paramount Pictures and Legendary signed a multi-year distribution deal in December, with Paramount Pictures distributing Legendary Entertainment films worldwide except China (Legendary East handles distribution in China). Street Fighter is the first film to be distributed under the new deal. Legendary Entertainment acquired the film and television rights to Street Fighter in April 2023, and will work with CAPCOM on future projects.

Sony Pictures was previously slated to distribute the film. When the film was still slated to be distributed by Sony Pictures , the film was planned to open on March 20, 2026, but Sony removed the film from its release calendar in March 2025.

Kitao Sakurai (The Eric André Show, Bad Trip) directed the film's shoot in Australia, which started in August 2025. Brothers Danny and Michael Philippou were initially slated to direct the film, but left the film to focus on making their Bring Her Back film.

The game series inspired a live-action film in 1994 starring Jean-Claude Van Damme , Raúl Juliá, Ming-Na Wen , Damian Chapa , Kylie Minogue , and Wes Studi . HYDE Park Entertainment produced a separate spinoff titled Street Fighter : The Legend of Chun-Li starring Kristin Kreuk in 2009.

Machinima produced the Street Fighter : Assassin's Fist and Street Fighter : Resurrection live-action series . Machinima released the first series on its YouTube channel in May 2014, and Funimation licensed the series for release in North America. Funimation released the series on Blu-ray Disc in October 2014. Machinima released the second series on Verizon's go90 streaming service in March-April 2016. A Street Fighter : World Warrior television series was originally planned in 2018.

Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie adapted CAPCOM 's video game Super Street Fighter II in 1994. Discotek Media released the film on DVD in December 2015, and on Blu-ray Disc in October 2016. The franchise has also inspired several other anime and animated series.

The Street Fighter 6 fighting game launched in June 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . CAPCOM released the game on Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025 as a launch title. The Street Fighter 6 Years 1-2 Fighters Edition version also launched on the same day.
author: ANN

Funimation released the series on Blu-ray Disc in October 2014. Machinima released the second series on Verizon's go90 streaming service in March-April 2016. A Street Fighter : World Warrior television series was originally planned in 2018.

Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie adapted CAPCOM 's video game Super Street Fighter II in 1994. Discotek Media released the film on DVD in December 2015, and on Blu-ray Disc in October 2016. The franchise has also inspired several other anime and animated series.

The Street Fighter 6 fighting game launched in June 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . CAPCOM released the game on Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025 as a launch title. The Street Fighter 6 Years 1-2 Fighters Edition version also launched on the same day.

title: Tsugumi Project Anime Reveals 1st 3 Cast Members
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of ippatu 's Tsugumi Project ( Tora Tsugumi ) manga announced the first cast members for the anime on Monday. Two of the three announced cast members perform in a newly released voice comic video for the manga:

The three cast members are:

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Leon

• Haruki Ishiya as Dudu

• Misaki Watada as Tsugumi

Kodansha USA Publishing published the manga and describes the story:

In the far future, a soldier named Leon is taken from his family on a trumped-up charge and dropped into a suicide mission: Recover a dangerous weapon from a deadly place — a place ruled by huge, irradiated, mutated monsters — a place once known, 200 years ago, as Japan. He and his teammates aren't expected to survive this place. One of the scant pieces of information they have is the weapon's name: Tsugumi.

Japanese artist ippatu drew the manga, and French publishser Ki-oon began releasing it as an original manga in France in 2019. Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine began serializing the manga in Japan in January 2021. The manga ended in September 2023, and got an epilogue chapter.

Kodansha published the manga's seventh and final compiled book volume in November 2023. Kodansha USA Publishing released the final volume in September 2025, and it shipped in France in February 2024.

title: Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club TV Anime Unveils 7-Episode Run, January 10 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club project for the Love Live! franchise unveiled a new key visual and the January 10 television premiere date for the anime on Sunday. The site also announced that the anime will have seven episodes, and will show the characters of the 106th class in stories set between April and June of their school year.

The anime will premiere on January 10 at 10:30 p.m. ( 8:30 a.m. EST) on the Tokyo MX channel, followed by BS11 , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , TV Aichi , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , and Shizuoka Broadcasting System later that day. It will also run on January 11 on Hokkaido Broadcasting, and on January 17 on Hokuriku Broadcasting .

The project also presented visuals of the new characters in the 106th class. (The game and anime film previously only featured characters from the 103rd to 105th class.)

Gō Kurosaki ( Shikizakura ) is directing the project at Sublimation . Fumiaki Maruto ( Engage Kiss , SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes , White Album 2 ) is writing the script. Haruko Iizuka ( Ensemble Stars! , Tamayura ) is designing the characters, Kaito Hamakawa is directing the CG, Keiichi Nozaki ( Ongaku Shōjo , L/R: Licensed by Royalty ) is directing the sound, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Apocalypse Hotel , Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) is composing the music with Lantis handling music production.

Other staff members include:

• Design Works: Yū Kisaragi

• Art Director: Yasuhiro Okumura

• Stage Concept Art: Marina Manode

• Color Key Artist: Hikari Komiya

• Compositing Director of Photography: Fumika Takahashi, Hiroshi Tanaka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

The staff remains mostly the same as the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party anime film, with the exception of Hikari Komiya as the color key artist (replacing Emi Chiba ), and the addition of Fumika Takahashi as compositing director of photography alongside the returning Hiroshi Tanaka .

The Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party 3D anime film opened in theaters in Japan on May 8. The film follows the final day before graduation of the 103rd class at the Hasu no Sora Girls' Academy.

The " Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club " idol group is part of the Love Live! franchise , and includes Kaho Hinoshita, Sayaka Murano, Kozue Otomune, Tsuzuri Yugiri, Rurino Osawa, and Megumi Fujishima, among others. The group is primarily featured in the Link! Like! Love Live! smartphone game app, which launched on April 15, 2023. Haruko Iizuka ( Little Busters! , Horimiya ) is designing the characters for the project. Odd No. Inc. is publishing the game. The group's first album Dream Believers debuted on March 29, 2023.

The game ended service on June 30 earlier this year. Odd No. filed for bankruptcy on August 5.

The project lets fans experience the story "together with school idols over 365 days" and let players "walk the path to graduation with the girls." In addition to the smartphone app, the idol club members (and their cast) stream videos, appear in magazines, release music CDs, hold concerts, among other efforts in various forms of media. A manga launched in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in November 2023.

The Love Live! school idol franchise launched in 2010 and has since spawned the Love Live! Sunshine!! , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Love Live! Superstar!! and most recently, Ikizu Live! Love Live! Bluebird project spinoffs.

title: The Simpsons Officially Brings Back Apu After 9 Years With New Voice Actor Revealed
content:
The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu to the animated series with a new voice actor after being missing in action for nearly a decade. The Simpsons Season 38 is now underway with new episodes airing this Fall, and with it fans have been treated to a second Treehouse of Horror Presents episode . But unlike the usual annual anthologies, this version of the special is allowed to tell other kinds of stories. Like explaining why Apu has been gone for such a long time.

The Simpsons Season 38 has now officially brought Apu back into the animated series nine years since he was last voiced by Hank Azaria, and Variety has confirmed that he’ll be now voiced by Sunil Malhotra ( The Legend of Vox Machina, Go Go Loser Ranger! ). The latest Halloween special episode even found a fun way to reintroduce him back into the fold as someone the town actively tried to ignore and forget.

The Simpsons Treehouse of Horror Presents Officially Reintroduces Apu

The Simpsons Season 38 “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening” takes place outside of the usual anthology and sees Springfield partying on Halloween night. Homer and a few others accidentally run over someone, and decide to hide the body instead of calling the police. When this person comes back for revenge the next year (much like seen in I Know What You Did Last Summer ), it turns out that the entire town had killed this same person and dumped the body over the course of the evening. This person turned out to be Apu.

Now voiced by Sunil Malhotra, this is the first time that Apu has openly spoken in The Simpsons since the Season 29 episode, “The Serfsons” back in 2017. Though the character has been spotted in a few crowd shots and background gags ( with as recent of an appearance in last year’s Treehouse of Horror episode ), this is an official reintroduction of the character. And is a way for the animated series to address head on that all of the characters (and the show itself) has been openly ignoring his absence for such a long time.

The Simpsons Finally Addresses Apu’s Absence

HT – Variety

title: 3 Spooky Anime You Should Watch on Netflix This October
content:
In the past few years, Netflix has emerged as a major anime streaming platform, and it wouldn’t be far-fetched to call it the second-largest. It has achieved this by offering many of the same anime available on Crunchyroll, with fans increasingly turning to Netflix as their main source for anime.

With October approaching its end, Halloween is just around the corner, and Netflix has a variety of anime to match the spooky vibe. However, these three are among the most recent additions, including one released this year as a successor to a masterpiece, with one even receiving its second season this year.

3) Dandadan

First released in 2024, with its second season arriving in 2025, Dandadan is a modern anime that is bizarre , action-packed, and, most importantly, spooky. The anime’s entire premise revolves around supernatural elements, including ghosts and the existence of aliens. With two protagonists who believe in the existence of these spooky phenomena, the anime constantly delivers bizarre moments that the characters only continue to highlight.

What makes this anime even more special is how Science SARU, the studio behind its animation, has taken an approach that further amplifies its spookiness. This includes using distinct color themes for the ghosts and aliens featured in the series, giving it a unique vibe. With this approach, the anime is vibrant and full of color, yet spooky and scary at the same time. Honestly, there is no anime quite like Dandadan when it comes to delivering the perfect Halloween vibe, as it is just as funny as it is spooky.

2) Daemons of the Shadow Realm

Daemons of the Shadow Realm is a new anime that arrived in Spring 2026 and is the second series from the creator of Fullmetal Alchemist , earning it the title of the masterpiece’s successor. There were many expectations for the series; however, fans didn’t expect it to be spooky as well. From the start, the anime establishes a dark, action-heavy vibe while subtly incorporating spooky elements through the daemons, essentially spirits that help their wielders.

These beings have existed for a long time and always come in pairs. With many daemons being unveiled, their origins, abilities, and appearances can make them seem frightening, something the series doesn’t shy away from depicting. It strategically incorporates them into horror and comedy elements, keeping the anime engaging. With a total of 24 episodes and an engaging narrative, the series is perfect for fans looking for action-heavy anime with a touch of horror this October.

1) Cyberpunk: Edgerunners

The best spooky anime Netflix has to offer is none other than its exclusive Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, based on the popular video game franchise Cyberpunk 2077. The anime captures the perfect sci-fi and spooky vibe of Night City from the game, presenting characters immersed in its most compelling elements. As an original anime, it is exceptionally well-written, with characters’ actions impacting others in ways that are bound to make fans cry as they watch the narrative unfold.

Across just 10 episodes, this anime is scary, dark, emotional, and occasionally funny, making it perfect not just for its spooky elements but also for its overall vibe. However, the biggest reason fans should watch it is that the anime’s second season is arriving on October 20 . While the two seasons aren’t directly connected, as the second will feature its own narrative, watching the first season will reveal what makes this anime so amazing and why it won the Anime of the Year award. With the Netflix exclusive Cyberpunk: Edgerunners returning with a new season this October, there honestly can’t be a better anime to watch on the streaming platform, especially one that delivers the perfect Halloween vibe.
